exam-qc-2026.name: Computer Science & Engineering Assessment 2026
exam-qc-2026.description: National multi-round examination assessing foundational algorithms, software systems architecture, and applied algorithmic programming.
exam-qc-2026.instructions: Please ensure you are in a quiet room with a stable network connection. Fullscreen mode is enforced. Exiting fullscreen or navigating to other tabs will trigger cheating warnings.

round-qc-1.name: Round 1: Screening & Core Fundamentals
round-qc-1.instructions: Answer all questions. Each correct answer carries 2 marks; incorrect answers deduct 0.5 marks.

round-qc-2.name: Round 2: Advanced Problem Solving & Synthesis (Open AI Permitted)
round-qc-2.instructions: Deep dive into advanced algorithms and systems. Open research and AI assistance are permitted for this round.
round-qc-2.failure_message: Thank you for applying. You did not achieve the required qualification marks for Round 2. Best of luck for future opportunities.

round-qc-3.name: Round 3: Advanced Hardware Architecture & Error Correction
round-qc-3.instructions: Implement the syndrome decoding algorithm in Python 3 or Java OpenJDK. Run syntax checks before submitting.
round-qc-3.success_message: Congratulations! You have completed all 3 assessment rounds with distinction. Our admissions committee will review your final score and submitted code.
round-qc-3.failure_message: Thank you for participating in the Quantum Computing Selection examination. Your score did not meet the final round threshold.

round-exam-1794411937843-2.instructions: Answer all 25 questions randomly drawn from the advanced problem solving bank. Qualifying marks: 20.
